label: Order
caption: U.S. DOGE SERVICE, ET AL. V. CITIZENS FOR RESPONSIBILITY AND ETHICS IN WASHINGTON
text: UPON CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicants and the response filed thereto, IT IS ORDERED that the April 15, 2025, and May 20, 2025 orders of the United States District Court for the District of Columbia, case No. 25-cv- 511, are hereby stayed pending further order of the undersigned or of the Court.
